name: Homefront
desc:
Warfare has broke out between the Federal Republic of Cascadia, the Yusanavian Alliance, and the Holy States of the Ellerman! Experience combined arms warfare, with both first and third person combat. Experience a unique blend of fast paced and tactical combat, with varied game modes ranging from civilian rescue operations, conquest, rush, survivor, and more! We boast a high performance experience available on all platforms.

Have suggestions or wish to report a bug? Post on our community forum! If you require staff assistance, such as for appealing a ban or reporting an exploiter, please contact us through the communications server. We also host factions and public events within our community.

Join the group for a free MP5K!
